name: Geoapify
tagline: Geocoding, places, routing, and map tiles for location-aware apps
description: Geoapify provides a suite of location APIs including geocoding, reverse geocoding, places search, routing, isochrones, map matching, and static/vector map tiles. Developers use an API key for authentication and can start on a free tier with higher paid plans for production volume.

auth.details: API key via apiKey query parameter or Authorization header; self-serve signup

example.response_snippet: {"type":"FeatureCollection","features":[{"type":"Feature","properties":{"formatted":"38 Upper Montagu Street, London, W1H 1LJ, United Kingdom","lat":51.52022,"lon":-0.16206},"geometry":{"type":"Point","coordinates":[-0.16206,51.52022]}}]}

use_cases: reverse geocode lat/lon to an address
generate static map images for locations
